id: title:GeneralistDev:run product analytics home queries in parallel

review.posthog_relevance: Product Analytics Home page performance and responsiveness. The change targets the initialization and scheduling of chart rendering and query execution for the Product Analytics home view, while warehouse and account queries retain their existing eager scheduling. This could reduce perceived latency for dashboard loading.
review.reason: The observed changes implement a batched scheduling strategy for the Product Analytics home page, replacing immediate execution with a scheduled start after a 0ms delay. This is a substantive, bounded implementation of a concurrency control improvement. P1.F2.H3 adds the scheduling flag, P1.F1.H2 applies it to the Product Analytics home, and P1.F6.H1 assigns load priority to chart,
review.uncertainty: The actual runtime benefit and reduction in CPU contention are not demonstrated by the code alone; the implementation relies on the underlying scheduler's behavior. No tests or metrics are shown. The distinction between warehouse and account queries remains unchanged, so the benefit is isolated to the Product Analytics home. No production incident or adoption is inferred.

observations.behavior: Adds batchStart option to ConcurrencyController constructor, scheduling next work after a 0ms delay rather than immediately.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows batching of queued work, potentially reducing immediate CPU contention or improving perceived responsiveness when multiple items arrive simultaneously.

observations.behavior: Changes concurrencyController instantiation for product analytics home to use batchStart: true, while other controllers remain eager.
observations.posthog_connection: Applies batched scheduling to product analytics home queries, while retaining eager scheduling for warehouse and account queries.

observations.behavior: Adds loadPriority prop to HomeTabChartCard and passes it to chart cards, while retaining eager scheduling for warehouse and account queries.
